summary_md: **Somi ([@somi_ai](https://x.com/somi_ai/status/2116681889218265442))** contrasts Qwen3.6-27B clicking through a spreadsheet task in 9:56 with Microsoft's 4B **Mage-VL-Cowork** coding it in 0:39; the model chooses per step between clicking (layouts), code (sheets, docs, slides) and terminal (verification) ([microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork)).
